title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance: Renewal Notice and Cancellation Terms by Plan
content:
Every Keyturn Roadside Assistance plan states the calendar days' notice required to end the
subscription, the percentage of the unused term returned on cancellation, the calendar days before
renewal that the member is told, and whether the term renews without the member acting.

| Plan | Notice to end the subscription (calendar days) | Percentage of the unused term returned on cancellation | Notice before renewal (calendar days) | The term renews without the member acting |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 14 | 0 per cent | 30 | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 14 | 50 per cent | 30 | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 14 | 50 per cent | 30 | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 14 | 50 per cent | 30 | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 30 | 75 per cent | 45 | yes |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 30 | 90 per cent | 60 | yes |

### Notes on the terms

1. All six plans renew without the member acting.
2. Notice to end the subscription stands at 14 calendar days on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, Keyturn
   Roadside Plus Cover, Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, and at 30 calendar
   days on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
3. Nothing of the unused term is returned on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, whose figure stands at 0
   per cent; the figure is 50 per cent on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover and
   Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, 75 per cent on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and 90 per cent on Keyturn
   Roadside Concierge Cover.
4. The member is told of a renewal 30 calendar days beforehand on the first four plans, 45 calendar
   days beforehand on Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover and 60 calendar days beforehand on Keyturn
   Roadside Concierge Cover.
